_comment: Ice survives only in permanently shadowed crater floors, so it is placed as shallow discs low in the terrain rather than as a surface sheet. The uniform IntProvider is FLAT in 26.2 - min_inclusive and max_inclusive sit beside `type`, not under a `value` object - and a plain simple_state_provider is all this needs; the rule_based wrapper was a nested provider missing its own `type`, which is two schema mistakes in one field.
